content_metadata.description: The video focuses on explaining the electron configuration of Strontium, including full and condensed notations, predicting ion formation, and visualizing valence electrons through an orbital diagram.

qAndA.question: What is the atomic number of Strontium?
What is the noble gas that precedes Strontium in the periodic table?
How many valence electrons does Strontium have?
What is the charge of the common ion formed by Strontium?

qAndA.answer: Because filling the 5s orbital is lower in energy than promoting an electron to the higher energy 4d orbital.
qAndA.question: Why are the valence electrons of Strontium located only in the 5s orbital?

activities.description: Explains the task and walks to get a marker
